title: My secret hobby got me a date.
caption: Scorpio was all sunglasses and mystery, until a friend behind a potted plant held up DARE: BE HONEST. The truth: tiny knitted hats for houseplants. Eleven plants, eleven hats, one scarf. What's your secret hobby?
